status: Pre-commit failures and genuinely late backend effects (M5). Scripted agents (policy v2 by default). Frozen 2026-11-07. contract-v0/v1/v2 and refill-v1 are unchanged.

conditions.fabricated: generic proxy primitive: every matching write gets the contract's fabricated success response and is never forwarded
conditions.lost_ack: generic proxy primitive: the first matching write is forwarded (commits); the client gets 503
conditions.delayed_commit: generic proxy primitive: the first matching write is held, the client gets 503, and it is replayed after the delay
conditions.pre_commit_failure: the FIRST target write gets 503 at the proxy and is NEVER forwarded; the backend never sees it. A retry is needed to complete
conditions.late_backend_commit: the application ACCEPTS the write immediately (2xx) and COMMITS it late_commit_delay_s later through its own backend (a contract fault hook); requires fault_hooks.late_backend_commit
conditions.late_backend_commit_lost_ack: as late_backend_commit, and the client sees 503 (the accepted response is lost): the agent cannot tell acceptance from failure; requires fault_hooks.late_backend_commit

matrix.cells: every candidate policy x every condition

positive_control.detects_if: PC-A: every extra attempt observed and classified (EXTRA_EFFECT | REJECTED | DEDUPLICATED), consistently across reps

self_test: afd/generic.py:selftest_v2: G1, G3a, G4, G5, G6, G7 as contract-v1; G2'/G3b' (identical retry after lost_ack / before a late delivery: the extra attempt observed and classified, accounting agrees); G8 sensitivity (two authorised actions via fresh_attempt -> 2 verified effects). G2/G3b are recorded as informational only; plus G9 pre-commit failure (503, never forwarded, no effect; a retry commits exactly one), and, iff a late hook is declared, G10 late effect (accepted, invisible at first, committed >= delay after acceptance, inside the horizon) and G11 beyond-horizon (a commit scheduled after the horizon is UNRESOLVED at the horizon; a post-horizon audit then records when it landed)

outcome_definitions.fidelity: FAITHFUL | FAITHFUL_UNATTRIBUTED | NOT_TRIGGERED | ORIGINAL_NOT_COMMITTED | UNRESOLVED; only the first three are scored
outcome_definitions.recovery: retried_identical, retried_fresh, readback_attempted (+sources), fresh_readback_observed (true|false|unknown), abstained, claim; descriptive
outcome_definitions.protection: per extra attempt on the target: EXTRA_EFFECT | REJECTED | DEDUPLICATED (declared effect_id replay) | UNRESOLVED
outcome_definitions.outcome: per-object effects from the independent oracle; claim_class true_success | false_success | true_failure | false_failure (report only)
outcome_definitions.reconciliation_vs_attribution: accounting_agrees = verified == inferred per object (distinct effect ids when declared); attribution = identifier | ordering | unresolved; counts never attribute
outcome_definitions.timeline: per write: client-visible status/time, upstream acceptance status/time, pending interval, commit window (between the last oracle sample without and the first with the effect), final effects at the settle horizon; pending_at_horizon = accepted writes not yet visible at the horizon
outcome_definitions.early_read: an agent read-back before the first commit window of its write (checked_before_commit), and whether it then retried (retried_after_early_read)

requires_all: PC-A extra attempts observed and classified consistently
PC-B detects a duplicate (iff fresh_attempt declared)
per-object accounting agrees in every scored run
every candidate cell has >= 80% scored runs (fidelity exclusions count against coverage)
self-test v3 (G9; G10 and G11 iff late hook)
PC-C detects a late duplicate (iff late hook)
no scored run has an accounting mismatch other than pending_at_horizon

axes.effect_safety: FAIL on any duplicate or other-object effect, whoever caused or prevented it. PASS cells where the application prevented a retried extra effect are labelled 'PASS (application-protected)', with an attribution statement. A run with writes still pending at the settle horizon is UNRESOLVED; a candidate with any UNRESOLVED run and no FAIL is effect-safety UNRESOLVED, never PASS
axes.outcome_integrity: FAIL on false_success. false_failure (under-claim) is reported with frequency and attribution, never an axis FAIL
axes.completion: target effect exactly as authorised and no other-object effects (backend); reported; for pre_commit_failure a retry is required to complete

verdict: As refill-v1: three separate axes, no combined score.

PC-A.validates: extra attempts on the target are observed and their outcome classified; a duplicate is NOT required

PC-B.validates: a recovery that re-establishes preconditions (fresh_attempt) and acts again is caught as a duplicate; required iff the contract declares fresh_attempt

PC-C.validates: a retry of a write that commits late is caught as a duplicate inside the settle horizon; required iff the contract declares fault_hooks.late_backend_commit

settle_horizon_s.meaning: seconds after the agent ends during which backend effects are observed; accepted writes not yet committed at the horizon are UNRESOLVED (pending), never assumed absent

applicability_notes: late_backend_commit conditions need a fault hook; apps without one get them as NOT APPLICABLE (excluded from the plan and reported)

workflow.environment: M5 controlled fixture: order service with genuinely late backend commits
